manifest.label: feasible-reset-v1
manifest.policy: 54 development Cube robot-only reset-center alignments with complete IK/collision/physics admission. Four paired Can numerical/contact counterfactuals on fixed already-grasping plans; alternate-model passes remain distinct. Object geometry, mass, inertia, friction and initial states unchanged. No held-out selection.

actuator_audit.meaning: Control replay equivalence; task and contact success remain separate recorded gates

physics_report.object_state_assignment: reset only; actuator commands only during all physics steps

assumptions: Robot-only gravity compensation; object gravity remains enabled
Planar ideal base servos; wheels locked
Manufacturer collision meshes used as convex hulls
Finger gains kp=8 kv=.8 torque limit=2 Nm; arm kp=180 kv=24 limit=40 Nm
Unspecified robot/environment friction=1,.01,.001; source Can friction retained

left_head.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

right_head.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

torso.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

conversion_assumptions: MuJoCo is not numerically equivalent to the source PhysX TGS solver
Equal source static/dynamic friction .3 maps to MuJoCo sliding .3; no source torsional/rolling coefficient is invented
Source restitution zero maps to critically damped MuJoCo solref .02 1; source PhysX contact offset .02 is not a surface inflation
MuJoCo contact mixing and the Reachy contact material replace the source Panda contact-pair behavior
Concave table profiles use source cap-triangle convex prisms; GLB float jitter and volume differences are measured
Recorded static table pose and complete collision geometry are retained; no tabletop-plane substitution
Source goal marker is hidden and noncolliding; its recorded goal remains in normalized arrays

missing_visual_assets.reason: source ground appearance only; infinite collision plane retained
